verses.text: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame; And the spirit of my understanding answereth me.

verses.text: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: They that have seen him shall say, Where is he?

verses.text: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

verses.text: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.

verses.text: His children shall seek the favor of the poor, And his hands shall give back his wealth.

verses.text: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.

verses.text: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.

verses.text: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; God will cast them out of his belly.

verses.text: He shall suck the poison of asps: The viper’s tongue shall slay him.

verses.text: He shall not look upon the rivers, The flowing streams of honey and butter.

verses.text: That which he labored for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down; According to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.

verses.text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: The hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.
